source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.11 with Fig. 9.21 (PDF 209-210).

blocks.text: Current le jane wale conductor ka ek hissa lein jis ki lambai L aur cross-section ka raqba A hai. Is hisse ka volume AL hai (Fig. 9.21). Maan lein n fi unit volume charge carriers ki tadaad hai; to kisi bhi waqt hisse mein charge carriers ki kul tadaad nAL hai. Agar ek carrier par charge q ho to kisi bhi lamhe hisse ke andar kul charge Q = nALq ... (9.29) hai. Aam taur par conductor mein charge carriers azaad electrons hain jin par manfi charge hai.

Maan lein conductor par potential difference lagane se charge carriers hisse ke baen rukh ki taraf chalte hain; tab electric current daen rukh ki taraf hai. Agar carriers ki drift velocity v ho to hisse mein shuru mein maujood tamam carriers ko baen rukh se nikalne mein waqt t = L/v lagta hai. Current ki tareef se I = Q/t. Q aur t ki qeematein rakhne par I = nALq/(L/v), ya I = nAvq ... (9.30).

blocks.title: Example (print mein 9.6 number)
blocks.text: Copper ke taar ka cross-sectional raqba 2 x 10^-6 m^2 hai aur us mein 3 A current hai. Agar fi unit volume electrons ki tadaad 8.5 x 10^28 m^-3 ho to taar mein electrons ki drift velocity nikalein (e = 1.6 x 10^-19 C). Hal: I = Anvq, to 3 = (2 x 10^-6)(8.5 x 10^28) v (1.6 x 10^-19), jis se v = 1.1 x 10^-4 m s^-1.

blocks.caption: Bahao dhakelne wale farq ke tanasub mein (Do You Know)

blocks.text: Current charge ka bahao hai, jise voltage harkat par majboor karta aur resistance rokta hai (For Your Information).

blocks.prompt: Copper ke taar par potential difference lagaya gaya hai. Azaad electrons ki drift velocity par kya asar hota hai jab (i) potential difference barhaya jaye, (ii) taar ki lambai aur temperature kam kiye jayein (constructed response 9.5)?
blocks.explanation: (i) Zyada potential difference taar ke andar zyada taqatwar field E = V/L deta hai, to takraon ke darmiyan electrons ko zyada zor se dhakela jata hai aur drift velocity barhti hai. (ii) Usi potential difference ke saath chhote taar mein bhi field zyada taqatwar hai, to drift velocity barhti hai; kam temperature par lattice ke atoms kam larazte hain, to takrao kam hote hain aur drift velocity mazeed barhti hai.

items: Lambai L aur raqba A ka hissa jis mein fi unit volume n carriers, charge q: Q = nALq (9.29); woh t = L/v mein nikalte hain; I = nAvq (9.30). Copper misal: v = 1.1 x 10^-4 m s^-1.
